## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The invitation password validator should also enforce twelve characters: it still accepts passwords below the minimum stated in the PR description.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — An eight-character password such as `"xxxxxxxx"` remains accepted by the invitation validator despite the new twelve-character requirement. This change leaves `app/invite.py:1` at eight, and `tests/test_invite.py:8` explicitly expects acceptance at that length. Update the invitation minimum and its boundary tests alongside signup and reset. — Invitation password validation permits passwords that signup and reset reject, leaving the stated security requirement incompletely enforced.

## Suggestions
(none)

## Strengths
- Signup and reset tests assert rejection at eleven characters and acceptance at twelve and thirteen.
